seo.meta_title: Togo's Catering: Box Lunches, Sandwich Trays and Prices
seo.meta_description: Togo's catering includes box lunches from about $15, sandwich trays for 8 from about $88, salads for 12 and cookie boxes. Prices, minimums and ordering.

question: How Much Does Togo's Catering Cost?
quick_answer: Togo's catering is built around box lunches and sandwich trays. Box lunches with a sandwich, chips and a cookie run about $15 to $19 per person, and a 9-inch box lunch is around $22. Sandwich trays that serve 8 cost about $88 to $94, group salads serving 12 are about $45 to $59, and a cookie and brownie box for 10 is about $21.50. Prices, delivery fees and minimums vary by location.
key_facts: Ordered online or through ezCater; prices vary

body.heading: Box lunches
body.text: Togo's box lunches are the go-to for office meetings because everyone gets their own meal. A regular 6-inch sandwich box lunch, with chips and a cookie, is about $17.50 at one Los Angeles location, and a vegetarian version is about $15.25. Other options include a wrap box, a salad box, a mini 3-inch sandwich with a half salad for about $16.50 to $19.25, and a large 9-inch sandwich box around $22, including a gluten-free version. Sandwiches come Togo's style with mayo, lettuce, tomatoes, onions, pickles and pepperoncinis.

body.heading: Sandwich trays
body.text: For a buffet, Togo's sandwich trays serve about 8 people. The Create-Your-Own tray lets you choose up to five sandwiches, cut into halves, and runs about $88 to $94. A signature tray mixes favorites like Turkey & Avocado, Roast Beef, Ham & Swiss, Turkey & Cheddar, the Italian and Albacore Tuna. Togo's big, meat-heavy subs, including the #9 Hot Pastrami, are what the chain is known for.

body.heading: Salads, sides, desserts and drinks
body.text: Group salads serve about 12 and cost roughly $45 for the Farmer's Market Salad up to $55 to $59 for chicken salads like the Asian Chicken, Santa Fe Chicken and Mediterranean Chicken. Bagged chips are about $2.29 each. For dessert, a cookie and brownie box for 10 is about $21.50, a cookie box about $19 and a brownie box about $24. Canned sodas and bottled water are also available.

body.heading: Ordering, fees and minimums
body.text: Togo's catering can be ordered online and through ezCater. Delivery fees, minimums and hours depend on the restaurant: some list no delivery minimum, while others require $50 to $100 or more, and delivery fees start around $10 to $40. Changes are usually accepted up to six business hours before the event, and late cancellations can carry a 50% fee. Utensils are a small add-on.

body.heading: About Togo's
body.text: Togo's was founded in 1971 in San Jose, California, by a college student who wanted big, fresh, meaty sandwiches he could afford. It now has locations mostly in California, with a few in other states such as Oregon. For individual sandwich prices, see our Togo's menu.

faqs.q: How much is a Togo's box lunch?
faqs.a: About $15 to $19 per person for most box lunches, and around $22 for a 9-inch sandwich box.

faqs.q: How many people does a Togo's sandwich tray feed?
faqs.a: A sandwich tray serves about 8 people and costs about $88 to $94.
Yes, many locations deliver through ezCater or Togo's online ordering. Fees and minimums vary.
Some locations offer a 9-inch gluten-free sandwich box lunch. Togo's notes that cross-contact is possible.

faqs.q: How far ahead should I order Togo's catering?
faqs.a: Order at least a day ahead for big groups. Changes are usually allowed up to six business hours before the event.
